title: Geopolitics: 5 Stories You Need Now

slides.headline: Geopolitics: 5 Stories You Need Now
slides.subtitle: Get the facts on global events moving the needle today.

slides.headline: US consulate in Toronto targeted again
slides.explanation: Police are searching for a suspect after shots were fired at the US consulate in Toronto. This is the second time this year the site has been attacked.

slides.headline: Supreme Court weighs in on mail-in ballots
slides.explanation: Donald Trump has asked the Supreme Court to allow new restrictions on mail-in voting. A lower court previously blocked these rules because it found he lacked the authority to change them.

slides.headline: Spyware lawsuit against Bahrain moves forward
slides.explanation: A British court ruled that activists can sue foreign governments for using spyware against them in the UK. This creates a new legal path for holding countries accountable for digital surveillance.

slides.headline: Ukraine brushes off Iranian threats
slides.explanation: Ukraine is dismissing warnings from Iran following a strike on a vessel in the Caspian Sea. Iran says the attack cannot go unanswered, signaling rising friction between the two nations.

slides.headline: Trump stands by defense pick Hegseth
slides.explanation: Donald Trump is publicly supporting Pete Hegseth amid ongoing tensions with Iran. Trump also said he paused military strikes on Iran to prioritize diplomacy for now.

caption:
From rising tensions in the Middle East to legal battles over voting rules, here is what is happening in the world today. We have broken down the five biggest stories so you can stay informed without the noise. Which of these updates surprised you the most?

title: Oil Drops and AI Stocks Surge

slides.headline: Oil Drops and AI Stocks Surge
slides.subtitle: Here are the five finance stories moving markets today.

slides.headline: Oil Prices Dip After Iran News
slides.explanation: Oil prices fell after the US paused attacks on Iran to prioritize diplomatic talks. This move suggests a potential cooling of tensions in the region.

slides.headline: Nvidia and OpenAI Deal Worries
slides.explanation: Investors are nervous about a reported deal where Nvidia might backstop a massive data center lease for OpenAI. Analysts warn this resembles risky habits seen during past tech bubbles.

slides.headline: AI Debt Pressure Grows
slides.explanation: High demand for AI-related bonds is creating strain across the wider bond market. Experts are watching closely as tech giants like Meta and Microsoft prepare to report earnings.

slides.headline: Sir Ian Wood Dies at 84
slides.explanation: The Scottish businessman and philanthropist has passed away at 84. He was best known for transforming his family boat repair shop into a global oil and gas engineering leader.

slides.headline: Chinese Chipmaker Soars 470%
slides.explanation: A Chinese chip company saw its stock price jump nearly 470 percent on its first day of trading. The massive debut highlights the intense global demand for AI hardware.
